criteria.title: kucode-install-agy passes bash -n, omits unsupported --skip-path/--skip-aliases flags, keeps official https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh hardcoded, and succeeds end-to-end against a strict mock install.sh accepting only -d/--dir and -h/--help while cleaning up staging temp dirs
kucode-install-agy isolates HOME during install.sh execution so post-install agy install cannot mutate real ~/.bashrc, ~/.profile, or ~/.zshrc, and preserves user-first PATH ordering
kucode-install-agy recovers cleanly from a pre-existing broken/empty ~/.local/bin/agy and upgrades a previously wrapped agy + agy.real installation without double-wrapping or leaving stale agy.real

kucode-install-agy preserves an existing working ~/.local/bin/agy untouched when download fails or when the staged binary fails --version (including exit code 159 SIGSYS with PROOT_NO_SECCOMP guidance)

kucode-install-agy retains ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 exec wrapper fallback (installing agy.real + 0755 /bin/sh wrapper with safe re-probe), checks curl/git/tar/gzip/sha512sum prerequisites, and verifies agy acp --help
Release version metadata is consistently bumped to 0.10.1 (versionCode = 12) across build.gradle.kts, PosixRuntimeConfig.RUNTIME_VERSION, and kucode-tools extension files
Physical XREAL AURA device executes kucode-install-agy && agy acp --login and connects in ACP chat panel
